name: Agnost AI Launch Video
text: A launch film for Agnost AI on language as the new interface, and the infrastructure making AI agents that actually understand what users want.

name: DUO Launch Video
text: A launch film positioning DUO as the starting point for AI-native home service businesses.

name: Creatin Launch Video
text: A launch film for Creatin, showing how brands and creators can run campaigns, deals, approvals, and payouts in one place.

name: Founder Journey Video
text: A founder origin film for Agnost AI, following Shubham and Parth from IIT to the Himalayas to building the world's first infrastructure for self-improving AI agents.

name: Agglayer Summit
text: A satirical campaign film for Agglayer Summit at Devcon Thailand 2024, centered on the idea of different chains coexisting with each other.

name: StarkHack
text: A bold, quirky film for StarkWare, telling the story of a coder being dragged into a police station for writing code too well.
